title: Dimension-shifting data for the site Čech vanishing criterion
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-site-cech-vanishing-criterion, for every U in B the degree-one cohomology vanishes and vanishing in degree p - 1 implies vanishing in degree p for p > 1.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: For a Čech-acyclic sheaf G and any short exact sequence with kernel G, apply surjective_sections_of_site_cech_h1_vanishing over every U in B. Its hypothesis quantifies over all product choices, whereas hcech is given for S: use SiteCechComplex.comparison_exists, whisker the resulting natural isomorphism with degree-one homology, and transport IsZero. This supplies section surjectivity for all such sequences.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: Prove uniformly for every Čech-acyclic G that H'(G,n+1,U) vanishes for all U in B, by induction on n. Embed G using Mathlib Injective.ι G, and form the actual cokernel with cokernel.π. Mathlib gives enough injectives for the small-site sheaf category, and exact_cokernel makes this a short exact sequence 0 -> G -> I -> Q -> 0. No arbitrary object is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: For n=0, let X be the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on yoneda(U). The composed free-forgetful and sheafification adjunctions, followed by yonedaEquiv, identify Hom(X,L) with L(U), naturally in L. Mathlib Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ and eq_zero_of_injective express any Ext¹(X,G) class as the boundary of y in Ext⁰(X,Q). Section surjectivity lifts the section corresponding to Ext.homEquiv₀ y to I(U), hence to a morphism a:X->I. Naturality gives a ≫ g = Ext.homEquiv₀ y. Thus y=Ext.mk₀ a composed with Ext.mk₀ g, whose boundary is zero by hE.comp_extClass and Ext.comp_assoc. This proves degree one.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: For the successor step, I has zero positive Čech cohomology. For a chosen covering K=S(V,T,W,f,h), map the short exact sheaf sequence to K.complexFunctor. Evaluate at each K.W(k,t): preservation of kernels gives exactness and injectivity of the first section map, and the first step gives surjectivity of the second since hB puts that intersection in B. Choose preimages componentwise to prove exactness and surjectivity for the product groups; injectivity follows componentwise. Mathlib shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact now gives a short exact sequence of the nonnegative Čech complexes, including empty products.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: The exact homology segment H^p(K,I) -> H^p(K,Q) -> H^{p+1}(K,G), supplied by hP.homology_exact₃, has zero outer terms for p>0. Exact.isZero_X₂ therefore gives zero Čech cohomology of Q. Apply the uniform induction hypothesis to Q. For X the free representable sheaf over U, Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ and injective Ext vanishing show every Ext^{n+2}(X,G) class is the boundary of an Ext^{n+1}(X,Q) class, which is zero by induction. Hence all classes vanish.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03F9, injective embedding and dimension-shifting paragraphs

proof.text: Specialize the uniform result to F to obtain H'(F,1,U)=0. Given p>1, write p=n+1 and use the same uniform result for degree p; it supplies the requested implication, even without its antecedent. This preserves the original theorem signature and uses the complete injective/cokernel route of Stacks 03F9.

lean.statement:
theorem siteCech_vanishing_dimension_shift
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    [HasSheafify J.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{r} (Sheaf J.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (B : Set C)
    (Cov : ∀ (U : C) (T : Type u) (V : T → C), (∀ t, V t ⟶ U) → Prop)
    (S : ∀ (U : C) (T : Type u) (V : T → C) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U),
      Cov U T V f → SiteCechComplex V f)
    (F : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hcover : ∀ (U : C) (T : Type u) (V : T → C) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U),
      Cov U T V f → Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U)
    (hB : ∀ (U : C) (T : Type u) (V : T → C) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U)
      (h : Cov U T V f), U ∈ B ∧ (∀ t, V t ∈ B) ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → T), (S U T V f h).W p a ∈ B)
    (hcofinal : ∀ (U : C), U ∈ B →
      ∀ (T : Type u) (V : T → C) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U),
        Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U →
        ∃ (K : Type u) (W : K → C) (g : ∀ k, W k ⟶ U),
          Cov U K W g ∧ ∀ k, ∃ (t : T) (a : W k ⟶ V t), a ≫ f t = g k)
    (hcech : ∀ (U : C) (T : Type u) (V : T → C) (f : ∀ t, V t ⟶ U)
      (h : Cov U T V f) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
        IsZero (((S U T V f h).cohomologyFunctor p).obj F.obj)) :
    ∀ U, U ∈ B →
      IsZero (H' F 1 U) ∧
        ∀ p, 1 < p → IsZero (H' F (p - 1) U) → IsZero (H' F p U)
